headlines.text: That Sunday in 2021, the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as The Young Bucks vs. Kingston & Moxley went to war, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 8.57 ? a genuine showstealer. It was the first title opportunity of Kingston & Moxley's career. The Young Bucks was chasing gold for the 10th time. A brawl right from the opening bell, with Moxley memorably chugging a fan's beer mid-fight ? a physical, hard-hitting title defense that saw the champions narrowly hold off two of AEW's toughest brawlers.

Flash back to 2026, when Hazuki touched down in AEW for the first time against Maya World, appearing on Collision, rated 7.00 ? a good, competitive contest. Making her AEW in-ring debut against Maya World with her future Owen Hart Cup opponent Persephone watching from commentary, the STARDOM standout Hazuki picked up the win with a Top Rope Senton.

It was 2021 when Kenny Omega vs. Orange Cassidy vs. PAC went to battle over the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 8.83 ? a genuine showstealer. It was the first title opportunity of PAC's career. A dramatic triple-threat main event story ? the champion resorted to hitting his challengers with all four of his collected titles just to survive, in front of a rabidly pro-Cassidy full-capacity crowd, before finally escaping with a crucifix pin.

secondaries.text: That Sunday in 2021, the AEW Women's World Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Britt Baker vs. Hikaru Shida battled it out, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 6.45 ? ending the champion's reign at 10 defenses. A passing of the torch after Shida's year-plus reign ? Baker's win capped a long campaign of psychological warfare and physical ambushes, finally toppling the champion via submission to claim the title for the first time.
Rewind to 2026, when the AEW International Title was up for grabs as Konosuke Takeshita vs. Daniel Garcia went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 7.98 ? a good, competitive contest.

Looking back to 2021, when Chris Jericho vs. Jake Hager vs. Ortiz vs. Santana vs. Sammy Guevara vs. Cash Wheeler vs. Dax Harwood vs. MJF vs. Shawn Spears vs. Wardlow settled things in a Stadium Stampede match, headlining the show on Double or Nothing, rated 7.32 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle, on an outstanding Double or Nothing '21 show that earned an overall rating of 8.64.
